s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent lesion of the nasal vestibule with local invasion
salient_findings: Recurrence of the lesion after excision
Tumor within the nasal vestibule floor and ala
key_facts: Female patient in her 50s
Never-smoker
Initial lesion biopsied 5 years prior
Initial biopsy reported as solid and cystic hidradenoma
p63 positive, pancytokeratin positive, and p16 negative on initial biopsy
Lesion recurred 8 months prior to presentation
Second excision showed p63 positive and p16 negative with positive margins
Imaging showed thicker right ala compared to the left ala
Tumor extended into the floor of the nasal vestibule
Microscopic examination showed downward papillomatous proliferation of small, uniform, slightly atypical keratinocytes

differentials: Pleomorphic adenoma of the nasal vestibule
per_call: Pleomorphic adenoma of the nasal vestibule

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Local invasion and recurrence of the lesion, with p63 positivity

shortlist.label: Inverted Papilloma
shortlist.why_kept: Papillomatous proliferation of keratinocytes and local invasion

shortlist.label: Malignant hidradenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Initial biopsy reported as solid and cystic hidradenoma, with recurrence and positive margins

shortlist.label: Hidradenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Similar to malignant hidradenoma, with aggressive behavior and local invasion

shortlist.label: Adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Possible given the glandular features and local invasion, although less likely than squamous cell carcinoma

raw.rationale: The microscopic examination showing downward papillomatous proliferation of small, uniform, slightly atypical keratinocytes is consistent with Inverted Papilloma, and the recurrence and extension into the nasal vestibule also support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: While p63 positivity could suggest squamous cell carcinoma, the microscopic features and lack of clear squamous differentiation markers make it less likely

rejected.label: Malignant hidradenoma
rejected.why: The initial biopsy was reported as a benign hidradenoma, and the current findings do not clearly indicate malignant transformation

rejected.label: Hidradenocarcinoma
rejected.why: Similar to malignant hidradenoma, the current findings do not clearly indicate malignant transformation of a hidradenoma

rejected.label: Adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: The microscopic examination does not show glandular differentiation typical of adenocarcinoma
